d616_basics.title: d616 Basics
d616_basics.description: Roll one Marvel die and two standard d6 dice, then total them for checks against a target number.

fantastic_roll.title: Fantastic Roll
fantastic_roll.description: If the Marvel die shows 1, treat the result as fantastic and add +6 to the roll total.

edges_troubles.title: Edges and Troubles
edges_troubles.description: Edge rolls an extra Marvel die and keeps the better result, with 1 treated as best (Fantastic). Trouble rolls an extra Marvel die and keeps the worse result under the same ranking.

powers.name: Teleportation
powers.description: Instantly move between locations within line of sight, bypassing intervening terrain.

powers.name: Blast
powers.description: Project focused energy at a target to inflict ranged damage.

powers.name: Regeneration
powers.description: Recover Health over time and resist lingering physical harm.
